_comment: Which deployable packages each catalogue agent offers. Ids: copilot-studio = Copilot Studio managed solution; m365-copilot = Microsoft 365 Copilot package. List a package for an agent ONLY once that package exists and has been installation-tested. 'default' is what every other catalogue agent offers: nothing, because those agents are concepts with a dossier and no installable package (launch-readiness finding LR-04). The agents page drawer, pay panel and generated factsheets read this; tests/product-release.test.mjs fails if the copy embedded in the pages drifts from this file.
